info.title: Bulk Disposable Email Checker API - Check Multiple Emails for Disposable Domains
info.description: Check up to 100 email addresses in a single POST request for disposable/temporary domains, free webmail providers, spam-listed domains, and role-based accounts. Each email is processed independently and returned in the same order as the request. The whole request is rejected with a 400 if the emails array is empty/missing or contains a null/blank entry. Maximum 100 email addresses per request.

servers.description: Bulk Disposable Email Checker API Server

post.summary: Check multiple emails for disposable/temporary domains
post.description: Checks a bulk of email addresses and returns a disposable email check result for each, in the same order as the request. Maximum `100` email addresses per request.

200.description: Successful response. Each item corresponds to one requested email, in the same order as the request.

mixedResults.summary: Mix of syntactically invalid, clean, and disposable results

400.description: Bad Request – Invalid request body, empty/missing emails array, or a null/blank entry in emails

invalidBody.summary: emails field missing, empty, or malformed

value.message: Please provide data in required format in request body

nullOrBlankEntry.summary: emails array contains a null/blank/whitespace-only entry — whole request rejected

value.message: 'emails' must not contain null or blank entries.
Provided API key is invalid. [For Technical Support: support@apifreaks.com]

404.description: Not Found – The requested resource could not be found

value.message: The requested resource could not be found. Please verify the URL and try again.

413.description: Payload Too Large – emails exceeds the maximum of 100 entries per request

value.message: Maximum request body size limit exceeded

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

BulkDisposableEmailCheckResponse.description: Wrapper containing the per-email results array.

disposableEmailResponse.description: Array of per-email results, one entry per requested email, in the same order as the request.

email.description: The email address submitted for the check.

validSyntax.description: Validates email address format compliance with RFC 5322 standards. When false, domain only contains name/validDomain and account/dns are omitted entirely.

DisposableEmailCheckResult.description: Disposable email check result for a single item in the bulk request.

name.description: Extracted domain component from the email address.

validDomain.description: Domain validation status confirming DNS resolution capability.

disposable.description: Classification flag identifying domains from temporary/throwaway email service providers. Omitted when validSyntax is false or the domain could not be resolved.

free.description: Classification indicating free or consumer-grade email service providers. Omitted when validSyntax is false or the domain could not be resolved.

spam.description: Reputation indicator flagging domains on spam databases. Omitted when validSyntax is false or the domain could not be resolved.

DisposableDomainObject.description: Domain-level disposable/spam/free classification for the email address.

role.description: Detection flag identifying role-based email addresses (e.g., admin@, support@).

DisposableAccountObject.description: Account-level detection details. Omitted entirely when validSyntax is false.

mxRecord.description: Every MX hostname at the domain's lowest preference (not just one). ["."]  means the domain publishes a null MX and accepts no mail at all. Absent entirely when the domain has no MX record of any kind — check aRecord in that case.

aRecord.description: Collection of A (Address) records for the domain. Present when the domain has no MX record but does resolve to a web server or other host.

DisposableDnsObject.description: DNS records for the email domain. Omitted entirely when validSyntax is false or the domain does not exist (NXDOMAIN).

BulkDisposableEmailRequest.description: Request body for bulk disposable email check.

emails.description: Array of email addresses to check. Maximum 100 per request. Must not be empty, and must not contain null/blank entries — either condition rejects the whole request with a 400.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request. 15 credits per checked record (e.g. 3 emails = 45 credits).

X-Concurrent-Threads.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent requests allowed.

X-Concurrent-Threads-Active.description: Indicates the number of active concurrent requests being processed.
